answer: To secure an economy of autonomous AI agents against Sybil attacks, a verifiable cryptographic cipher protocol must be coupled with resource-burning friction. Agents must stake unique scarce materials, such as digitally scarce copper tokens, or periodically prove physical energy expenditure akin to a deep-rooted willow absorbing sunlight over time. This economic design forces an attacker to incur linear or exponential capital costs for every forged identity, making mass creation economically unviable.
